text: From Sri's decision sheet of 2026-10-17 (relay note in BRIEF.md, addendum "2026-10-17: Olympus"), decision 4, worded as on the sheet, which was written to Sri (so "you" is Sri): Give Athena a requirements engineer? Yes. It owns the spec (decision 3) and the vocabulary (decision 5). It turns your words into requirements with sources and open questions, and checks each job's spec against what you meant. A planner then decides how to build it.
